post.headline: A tenant in Benin went to tribunal before quit notice arrived
lines: Her landlord wanted everyone out before Christmas to raise rent next year.
She filed an application at the Rent Tribunal first.
In Edo State, once a tenant applies to the Rent Tribunal, any quit notice served afterwards has no effect.
post.cta: Did your landlord serve you notice before Christmas? Tell us below.

threads.text: A tenant in Benin filed a dispute at the tribunal. The landlord served a notice to quit two days later. In Edo State, once an application reaches the Rent Tribunal, a notice served afterwards has no effect. Did your landlord serve you notice this month?
threads.evening: In Edo State, filing an application at the Rent Tribunal stops any quit notice served afterwards cold.

why: Sunday engagement post combining the STORY hook with the seasonal end-of-year quit notice pressure in Edo State.
